name: cf-browser
description: A real cloud browser on Cloudflare Browser Run: saved logins in an everyday profile, human handoff for logins and 2FA through Live View, a daily budget, and browsers that close themselves so nothing keeps billing.

interface.shortDescription: Cloud browser on Cloudflare Browser Run
interface.longDescription: Drive a real Chromium in Cloudflare Browser Run. Logins are kept in an everyday profile, you log in yourself through a Live View handoff (the agent never types passwords), you can watch read-only before submits, and browsers close themselves when idle, at a max age and when Codex exits. Also Quick Actions with Kitesurf, crawls, recordings with a replay page, guardrails and WebMCP.
